_comment: Trust roots for the merge review gate and the checker runner. CODEOWNED and high risk: a change here changes who can attest. Both tools read it from the trusted default-branch checkout, never from a PR. Null or empty values keep that path OFF and fail closed. See docs/merge-review.md.

checkerApp._comment: Numeric App id and the App's bot user id, read from the App settings page and GET /users/<slug>[bot] after the App exists. Until both are set no App receipt counts.

independentReviewers._comment: Numeric user ids of humans who are independent of every agent harness. Empty means no human approval counts. Never add the owner account: every harness shares its gh login.

nonIndependent._comment: Identities that never count as an independent reviewer: the shared owner login and harness or automation accounts.

deniedApps._comment: Apps that may never be the checker, whatever checkerApp says.

seatVendors._comment: Seat -> model vendor. Shared by runner and gate. null means the vendor is not verifiable, so that seat can never be shown independent of a maker.

branchHarnesses._comment: Head-branch harness name (agent/<harness>/...) -> maker seat. The branch is a claim; commit trailers and authors add vendors to it.

vendorPatterns._comment: Case-insensitive regexes matched against commit trailers and commit author and committer name, email and login.

c940._comment: The self-hosted job never holds the App key; it uploads a review signed with this SSH key, which a hosted job verifies before posting. null keeps the C940 path OFF.
